title: PERSUBENTMGR Autodesk API authority screen
scope: Determine whether official Autodesk API documentation supplies enough authority to interpret the remaining PERSUBENTMGR body and implement a typed graph route.

sources.title: AssocPersSubentityIdPE Class
sources.observation: Documents the AcDbAssocPersSubentIdPE protocol extension for persistent querying and manipulation of entity subentities, including common entity types.
sources.limitation: Does not document AcDbPersSubentManager field order, DWG encoding, stored member arrays, owner/reactor roles, or dependency graph semantics.

sources.title: entmod Function
sources.observation: Lists AcDbPersSubentManager with DXF class name ACDBPERSSUBENTMANAGER.
sources.limitation: The class-name mapping does not establish the class-specific DWG wire schema or graph closure.

decision: Official API documentation clarifies the persistent-subentity identification concept, but does not resolve the class-specific DWG field spans, nonzero member representation, or graph dependencies. The existing ACadSharp SAVEAS corpus and independent peer traces remain bounded/partial and already have receipts; do not repeat them or treat peer agreement as schema proof.
next: Obtain one producer-bound AutoCAD/ObjectARX source containing a deliberately selected, nonzero persistent subentity path on a known 3DSOLID or REGION, with matching versioned DXF and close/reopen API state. Bind typed member fields, owner/reactors, dependent target identities, full body span, handle roles, and following-object boundary before adding typed output. Keep unknown tails raw and strict output refused until independent readback and native semantics pass.
